entities.summary: Canon Michael Gamper (1885–1956) was an Austrian priest seen as a hero of the Tyrol between the world wars. He is an important figure in the disputed zone between what is now Austria and Italy. He was editor of the papers Südtiroler Volksbote and Dolomiten.
